Aisha (CS): MediBridge requests a short promo onboarding: route traffic into me-west-2, add partner CIDR allowlist, SAML SSO setup, and a temporary QPS bump for 14 days. Also asked for a KMS note for procurement/renewal.

Salim (MediBridge): Confirming dates 2025-05-05 -> 2025-05-19, peak 08:00-20:00 GST. Baseline 200 QPS; need burst to 750 for /v1/generate. CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24 and 198.51.101.12/32. Egress ~180Mbps.

Rina (NetOps): Copy. Can open peering to me-west-2 and create ephemeral allowlist with auto-revoke. Any client certs?

Salim (MediBridge): No client certs for now. Token auth is fine.

Carlos (Solutions Eng): Plan: 1) ephemeral allowlist auto-revoke 2025-05-20, 2) apply tmp QPS profile "medi-promo-750" scoped to me-west-2 and /v1/generate, 3) schedule 30m SAML exchange, 4) capture KMS isolation note for renewal doc.

Jordan (AE): I'll draft the renewal attestation and loop in Security.

Aisha (CS): I'll book the SAML call for tomorrow 14:00 GST and create runbook. Rina, please open ticket and set monitoring alert at 75% of promo capacity -> escalate to @Aisha.

provision-bot: Created ticket CS-9007. Peering PoP reservation ETA 20h. Promo profile applied to staging; auto-revoke timer set.

Rina (NetOps): Done. Allowlist entries applied in staging; audit logging enabled. Will post CS-9007 updates here when PoP reserved.

Salim (MediBridge): Thanks team, please ensure allowlist is temporary and logs available for audit.

Aisha (CS): Noted. Recap in CS-9007: peering, ephemeral allowlist, promo profile, SAML call tomorrow 14:00 GST, renewal doc owned by Jordan. Ping thread for changes.

(END)
